_read_me: migration-drift-schema suite (config/benchmarks/migration-drift-schema.json). Each entry is one statement `prisma migrate diff --from-migrations prisma/migrations --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma --script` prints for an object that exists only as raw SQL because schema.prisma cannot declare it. List a statement ONLY when it appeared in a real CI run of this suite and the reason names the migration that created the object and why the schema language cannot express it. A statement that drops or changes anything schema.prisma could declare is real drift: fix the schema or add the migration instead of listing it here. Statements are compared with comments dropped and whitespace collapsed.

exemptions.reason: HNSW index on DocumentChunk.embedding, created by migration 20260610120100_add_document_embeddings for vector search. schema.prisma models the column as Unsupported("vector(768)") and Prisma's @@index has no HNSW type, so the index cannot be declared.

GIN index on the generated DocumentChunk.fts column, created by migration 20260624120000_add_chunk_provenance for the full-text leg of hybrid search. schema.prisma models fts as Unsupported("tsvector"), and Prisma cannot declare an index on an Unsupported field.

HNSW index on ProgramDocument.embedding, created by migration 20260610120100_add_document_embeddings for vector search. schema.prisma models the column as Unsupported("vector(768)") and Prisma's @@index has no HNSW type, so the index cannot be declared.

HNSW index on SageMemory.embedding, created by migration 20260610200000_add_sage_memory_and_operations for memory recall. schema.prisma models the column as Unsupported("vector(768)") and Prisma's @@index has no HNSW type, so the index cannot be declared.

exemptions.statement: ALTER TABLE "visionquest"."DocumentChunk" ALTER COLUMN "fts" DROP DEFAULT;
exemptions.reason: DocumentChunk.fts is GENERATED ALWAYS AS (to_tsvector('english', "content")) STORED, from migration 20260624120000_add_chunk_provenance. Prisma reads the generation expression as a default that Unsupported("tsvector") cannot carry, and proposes dropping it.
